lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. These clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern with the highest intensity nodes concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly prominent in the mid-flank area behind the pectoral fin attachment point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, each defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high pixel values on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
